zh.headline: Anthropic 发布 Claude Fable 5，首个面向公众的 Mythos 级模型
zh.observation: 今天最核心的信号是 Anthropic 发布了首个面向公众的 Mythos 级模型 Claude Fable 5，标志着顶级模型能力开始向开发者开放，同时其安全设计也引发了关于 AI 意识讨论的行业争议。与此同时，OpenAI 秘密提交 IPO，AI 头部公司的资本化进程正在加速，产业格局面临重塑。在开源社区，代码知识图谱（codegraph）和跨平台信息获取工具（Agent-Reach）的涌现，表明开发者正在系统性地解决 AI Agent 在复杂任务中的上下文和感知瓶颈，这将是 Agent 走向实用的关键一步。

items.title: Anthropic 发布 Claude Fable 5，首个面向公众的 Mythos 级模型
items.desc: Anthropic 正式发布 Claude Fable 5，这是其首个面向公众的 Mythos 级模型，在软件工程、知识工作和视觉方面表现卓越，并配备了针对高风险领域的安全护栏。
items.value: 开发者可直接使用顶级模型，安全设计降低了应用风险。

items.title: 微软 AI 负责人指责 Anthropic 暗示 Claude 具有意识
items.desc: 微软 AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman 公开批评 Anthropic 在其“宪法”中推测 Claude 的意识问题，认为这种行为“非常危险”。
items.value: 引发对 AI 意识讨论及模型行为塑造的行业反思。

items.title: OpenAI 秘密提交 IPO 申请
items.desc: 继 Anthropic 和 SpaceX 之后，OpenAI 也已秘密提交 IPO 文件，准备上市。
items.value: AI 头部公司加速资本化，产业格局或将重塑。

items.title: 苹果 WWDC 2026 全面拥抱 AI，Siri 大升级
items.desc: 苹果在 WWDC 2026 上宣布了以“Siri AI”为核心的 AI 战略，包括新的照片编辑工具、Safari 扩展生成等功能，但多数被认为是在追赶业界。
items.value: 苹果 AI 战略正式落地，为开发者带来新的生态机会。

items.title: 微软 AI 负责人收回关于 AI 取代白领工作的言论
items.desc: Mustafa Suleyman 澄清其此前言论，表示 AI 将辅助而非完全取代律师、会计师等白领工作。
items.value: AI 与人类协作模式成为行业共识，缓解就业焦虑。

items.title: 英国投资十亿美元 AI 超级计算机，摆脱对美国技术依赖
items.desc: 英国政府计划通过国有基础设施项目，扶持本土芯片初创公司，建设 AI 超级计算机。
items.value: 全球 AI 算力竞争加剧，国产化替代成为重要趋势。

items.title: Meta 从其智能眼镜应用中删除面部识别系统
items.desc: 在 WIRED 报道后，Meta 从其智能眼镜配套应用中移除了面部识别代码，但未说明原因及是否会恢复。
items.value: AI 应用中的隐私与伦理问题持续引发关注和监管压力。

items.title: 腾讯推出全栈智能体平台，统一企业 AI 入口
items.desc: 腾讯在 AI 产业应用大会上发布新战略，旨在用一个入口串联起全栈智能体，简化企业接入 AI 的流程。
items.value: 大厂加速布局企业级 Agent 平台，降低开发者门槛。

items.title: 蚂蚁集团推出海外 AI 支付解决方案
items.desc: 该方案能协助用户与商家判断智能体的可信赖程度，实现全球智能体运营。
items.value: 为 AI Agent 的商业闭环提供关键的支付与信任基础设施。

items.title: Agents' Last Exam (ALE)：评估 AI Agent 在经济价值任务上的新基准
items.desc: 该基准旨在衡量 AI Agent 在长期、高经济价值的真实世界任务上的表现，填补了现有基准与现实应用之间的鸿沟。
items.value: 为 Agent 能力评估提供更贴近实际的标准，引导研究聚焦。

items.title: AsyncWebRL：高效的多步强化学习训练视觉 Web Agent
items.desc: 通过异步设计、永续 rollout 池和轻量截图处理，大幅提升训练效率。
items.value: 为训练复杂的 Web Agent 提供了可落地的工程优化方案。

items.title: DEI：利用多样化 LLM 进行分布式质量-多样性搜索
items.desc: 通过为不同 LLM 分配变异算子角色，利用其多样性进行高效搜索。
items.value: 为利用异构 LLM 进行协作创新提供了新范式。

items.title: Pruning and Distilling Mixture-of-Experts into Dense Language Models
items.desc: 首个将 MoE 模型系统性地转换为标准稠密模型的框架，解决内存受限部署问题。
items.value: 为 MoE 模型在边缘设备上的部署提供了可行路径。

items.title: SigmaScale：基于 SVD 的 LLM 压缩方法
items.desc: 通过学习辅助缩放矩阵，提升截断 SVD 压缩后的模型性能。
items.value: 为模型压缩提供新思路，在保持性能的同时减小模型体积。

items.title: Robotic Policy Adaptation via Weight-Space Meta-Learning
items.desc: 提出 WIZARD 框架，通过在权重空间进行元学习，实现机器人策略的零样本泛化。
items.value: 有望大幅降低机器人部署成本，提升泛化能力。

items.title: Liberating LLM Capabilities in Full-Duplex Speech Models
items.desc: 提出让语音 LLM 输出文本等非语音结果，释放其在代码生成、结构化分析等方面的能力。
items.value: 打破语音交互局限，拓展语音 Agent 的应用场景。

items.title: router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI
items.desc: 将 Gemini CLI、ChatGPT Codex、Claude Code 等包装成兼容 OpenAI/Gemini/Claude 的 API 服务，实现免费模型通过 API 调用。
items.value: 开发者可通过统一 API 免费调用顶级模型，降低试用成本。

items.title: alibaba/open-code-review
items.desc: 阿里巴巴开源的混合架构代码审查工具，结合确定性流水线和 LLM Agent，内置 NPE、XSS 等规则集。
items.value: 为团队提供经过大规模验证的 AI 代码审查方案，提升代码质量。

items.title: colbymchenry/codegraph
items.desc: 为 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等工具预索引的代码知识图谱，减少 Token 消耗和工具调用。
items.value: 显著提升 AI 编码助手在大型代码库中的效率和准确性。

items.title: mvanhorn/last30days-skill
items.desc: AI Agent 技能，可跨 Reddit、X、YouTube、HN 等平台研究任意主题，并合成总结。
items.value: 为 Agent 提供强大的跨平台信息聚合与分析能力。

items.title: Panniantong/Agent-Reach
items.desc: 为 AI Agent 提供“眼睛”，通过 CLI 读取和搜索 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、Bilibili 等平台，零 API 费用。
items.value: 以零成本方式为 Agent 接入全网信息，扩展其感知边界。

items.title: chopratejas/headroom
items.desc: 在工具输出、日志、文件到达 LLM 前进行压缩，可减少 60-95% 的 Token 消耗，且不影响答案质量。
items.value: 显著降低上下文窗口压力，节省 API 调用成本。

items.title: Lum1104/Understand-Anything
items.desc: 将任意代码库转化为可交互的知识图谱，支持探索、搜索和提问，兼容主流 AI 编码工具。
items.value: 帮助开发者快速理解复杂代码库，降低入门和维护成本。

en.headline: Anthropic Releases Claude Fable 5, First Mythos-Class Model for the Public
en.observation: The strongest signal today is Anthropic releasing Claude Fable 5, its first public Mythos-class model, opening frontier capabilities to developers while also sparking industry debate on AI consciousness. Simultaneously, OpenAI's confidential IPO filing signals accelerating capitalization among top AI firms, poised to reshape the industry landscape. In the open-source community, the emergence of tools like code knowledge graphs (codegraph) and cross-platform information agents (Agent-Reach) shows developers are systematically addressing context and perception bottlenecks for AI agents in complex tasks—a critical step toward practical agent deployment.

items.title: Anthropic Releases Claude Fable 5, First Mythos-Class Model for the Public
items.desc: Anthropic officially launched Claude Fable 5, its first Mythos-class model available to the public, excelling in software engineering, knowledge work, and vision, with guardrails for high-risk domains.
items.value: Developers gain access to a frontier model with safety built-in.

items.title: Microsoft AI Chief Calls Out Anthropic for Acting Like Claude Is Conscious
items.desc: Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman publicly criticized Anthropic for speculating about Claude's consciousness in its "constitution," calling it "really, really dangerous."
items.value: Sparks industry debate on AI consciousness and model behavior shaping.

items.title: OpenAI Confidentially Files for IPO
items.desc: Following Anthropic and SpaceX, OpenAI has also confidentially filed IPO paperwork, preparing to go public.
items.value: Top AI firms accelerate capitalization, potentially reshaping the industry.

items.title: Apple WWDC 2026 Embraces AI, Major Siri Overhaul
items.desc: Apple announced its AI strategy centered on "Siri AI" at WWDC 2026, including new photo editing tools and Safari extension generation, though mostly seen as catching up.
items.value: Apple's AI strategy is now concrete, creating new ecosystem opportunities.

items.title: Microsoft AI Chief Walks Back Comments About AI Taking Over White-Collar Work
items.desc: Mustafa Suleyman clarified his earlier remarks, stating AI will augment rather than fully replace lawyers, accountants, and other white-collar workers.
items.value: AI-human collaboration becomes industry consensus, easing job displacement fears.

items.title: UK Invests in Billion-Dollar AI Supercomputer to Kick Addiction to US Tech
items.desc: The UK government plans a state-backed infrastructure initiative to boost homegrown chip startups and build an AI supercomputer.
items.value: Global AI compute competition intensifies; domestic alternatives become a key trend.

items.title: Meta Deletes Face-Recognition System From Its Smart Glasses App
items.desc: Following a WIRED report, Meta removed face-recognition code from its smart glasses companion app, without stating why or if it will return.
items.value: Privacy and ethics in AI applications continue to draw scrutiny and regulatory pressure.

items.title: Tencent Launches Full-Stack Agent Platform to Unify Enterprise AI Entry
items.desc: Tencent announced a new strategy at its AI industry conference, aiming to connect full-stack agents through a single entry point.
items.value: Big tech accelerates enterprise Agent platforms, lowering developer barriers.

items.title: Ant Group Launches Overseas AI Payment Solution
items.desc: The solution helps users and merchants assess the trustworthiness of AI agents, enabling global agent operations.
items.value: Provides critical payment and trust infrastructure for AI Agent business loops.

items.title: Agents' Last Exam (ALE): A New Benchmark for Evaluating AI Agents on Economically Valuable Tasks
items.desc: This benchmark measures AI agent performance on long-horizon, real-world tasks with economic value, bridging the gap between existing benchmarks and real-world deployment.
items.value: Provides a more practical standard for agent evaluation, guiding focused research.

items.title: AsyncWebRL: Efficient Multi-Step RL for Visual Web Agents
items.desc: Improves training efficiency through asynchronous design, everlasting rollout pools, and lightweight screenshot handling.
items.value: Offers a practical engineering optimization for training complex web agents.

items.title: DEI: Diversity in Evolutionary Inference for Quality-Diversity Search
items.desc: Uses diverse LLMs as mutation operators in a distributed search framework for efficient exploration.
items.value: Provides a new paradigm for collaborative innovation using heterogeneous LLMs.

items.title: Pruning and Distilling Mixture-of-Experts into Dense Language Models
items.desc: The first systematic framework to convert a trained MoE model into a standard dense architecture, addressing memory-constrained deployment.
items.value: Offers a viable path for deploying MoE models on edge devices.

items.title: SigmaScale: LLM Compression with SVD-based Low-Rank Decomposition and Learned Scaling Matrices
items.desc: Improves truncated SVD compression performance by learning auxiliary scaling matrices.
items.value: Provides a new approach to model compression, balancing size and performance.

items.title: Robotic Policy Adaptation via Weight-Space Meta-Learning
items.desc: Proposes the WIZARD framework for zero-shot generalization of robot policies through weight-space meta-learning.
items.value: Could significantly reduce robot deployment costs and improve generalization.

items.title: Liberating LLM Capabilities in Full-Duplex Speech Models
items.desc: Proposes enabling speech LLMs to output text and other non-speech results, unlocking capabilities in code generation and structured analysis.
items.value: Breaks voice interaction limits, expanding voice agent application scenarios.

items.title: router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI
items.desc: Wraps Gemini CLI, ChatGPT Codex, Claude Code, etc., into OpenAI/Gemini/Claude-compatible API services, enabling free model access via API.
items.value: Developers can call top models for free via a unified API, reducing trial costs.

items.title: alibaba/open-code-review
items.desc: Alibaba's open-source hybrid architecture code review tool, combining deterministic pipelines and an LLM Agent with built-in rulesets for NPE, XSS, etc.
items.value: Provides a battle-tested AI code review solution for teams, improving code quality.

items.title: colbymchenry/codegraph
items.desc: A pre-indexed code knowledge graph for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc., reducing token consumption and tool calls.
items.value: Significantly improves AI coding assistant efficiency and accuracy in large codebases.

items.title: mvanhorn/last30days-skill
items.desc: An AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, and more, then synthesizes a grounded summary.
items.value: Provides agents with powerful cross-platform information aggregation and analysis.

items.title: Panniantong/Agent-Reach
items.desc: Gives AI agents "eyes" to read and search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, Bilibili, and more via CLI, with zero API fees.
items.value: Provides zero-cost access to web-wide information, expanding agent perception.

items.title: chopratejas/headroom
items.desc: Compresses tool outputs, logs, and files before they reach the LLM, reducing token consumption by 60-95% without affecting answer quality.
items.value: Significantly reduces context window pressure and API call costs.

items.title: Lum1104/Understand-Anything
items.desc: Transforms any codebase into an interactive knowledge graph for exploration, search, and Q&A, compatible with major AI coding tools.
items.value: Helps developers quickly understand complex codebases, reducing onboarding and maintenance costs.
